items.assumption: ClayCode surface/compiler must preserve distinct state, provenance, semantic identity and effect-authority boundaries required by FRANK.
items.independent_check: Executed parser/canonical-hash/fail-closed mutations directly against current ClayCode source/dialect rather than treating FRANK agreement as replication.
items.result: The boundary requirement survives, but parser success alone is insufficient: boolean identity and keyword-field identity produced concrete counterexamples until the lexical repair.

items.result: D is locally viable and leading on migration cost, but target-reader/compiler evidence is required before selection.
